_registration.official_name: Entry Visa for Foreign Technical Specialists at Ports
_registration.purpose: A one-month non-renewable visa issued at a Lebanese port for foreign technical or administrative experts brought in by an enterprise, applied for through the Bureau of Public Relations; stays beyond a month fall under the first-class worker rules instead.

source_titles.requirements_65: A visa for a foreign expert at a port

policy: Every requirement below is bound to a verbatim excerpt from the Lebanese General Directorate of General Security page named in source_roles. Nothing is paraphrased into an excerpt and nothing is inferred. Every excerpt was taken by line offset out of a NUMBERED dump of text this project’s own fetcher retrieved and this project’s own normaliser processed, then re-verified against a fresh fetch.
structure_note:
The whole route turns on ONE MONTH. Under it, the enterprise applies through the Bureau of Public Relations for a non-renewable one-month visa against a seven-document list. Over it, the authority does not extend this route at all — it redirects to the modalities for a first-class worker, which is a different regime entirely. Both halves are published so nobody plans a six-week assignment on a one-month route.

The page also carries the seafarer transit visa, which is a different route on the same page and is registered here as a condition rather than split out, because the authority publishes no document list for it.
freshness_note: The page publishes no dateline and no Last-Modified header, and its body references 2026. Freshness therefore rests on a body-year rather than a publication date — the same state check-source-freshness already reports for Singapore's MOM pages, the US ESTA pages and all of Austria's migration.gv.at. The daily sync is what will notice if the text moves.
not_extracted: Residence Permits for Iraqi Nationals in Lebanon (posts/428). The served page carries five lines that refer to "the residency mentioned in item (2) above" and "residency applications mentioned in item (1) above" — and items (1) and (2) are NOT on the page in any form, in the normalised text or in the raw HTML. Publishing a cross-reference to a list the reader cannot see would be worse than publishing nothing.
The Arabic-language tree. This authority publishes English and Arabic separately; only the English tree is read, and no claim is made that the two say the same thing.

Routes still enumerated on the index and not yet extracted: sponsorship transfer applications, the complaint procedure for an escaping foreign worker, temporary residence renewal via LibanPost, applying for a visa renewal via Liban Post, the kafala-transfer regularisation, entry of nationals from labour-supplying countries, work permits for foreign artists and musicians, entry of artists in nightclubs, and the Syrian and Palestinian arrangements. Named so the gap is a known quantity rather than an impression of completeness.

requirements.label: Who this covers: foreign experts brought for technical or administrative work
requirements.description: Granted a visa at a port.
requirements.source_excerpt: the foreign experts brought for technical or administrative work are granted a visa at a port as follows:
requirements.source_excerpt_display: The foreign experts brought for technical or administrative work are granted a visa at a port as follows:

requirements.label: Stays up to 1 month: the ENTERPRISE applies via the Bureau of Public Relations, and the visa is NON-RENEWABLE
requirements.description: Three facts in one sentence: who applies, where, and that it cannot be extended.
requirements.source_excerpt: 1- if the length of his stay doesn’t exceed 1 month , the concerned enterprise will apply for a one month non renewable visa via the bureau of public relations. the following documents are requested:
requirements.source_excerpt_display: 1- If the length of his stay doesn’t exceed 1 month, the concerned enterprise will apply for a one month non renewable visa via the bureau of public relations. The following documents are requested:

requirements.label: A certified copy of the expert’s passport, valid at least 6 months
requirements.source_excerpt: 11- a certified copy of the passport of the foreigner valid for 6 months at least.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: 11- A certified copy of the passport of the foreigner valid for 6 months at least.

requirements.label: Certified copies of the enterprise’s official documents
requirements.description: The authority gives the commercial register as its own example.
requirements.source_excerpt: 12- certified copies of the official documents related to the enterprise or institution (e.g. register commercial).
requirements.source_excerpt_display: 12- Certified copies of the official documents related to the enterprise or institution (e.g. register commercial).

requirements.label: A certified copy of the director’s or owner’s ID or civil-status extract
requirements.source_excerpt: 13- a certified copy of the id card or the extract of civil status of the director or owner.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: 13- A certified copy of the ID card or the extract of civil status of the director or owner.

requirements.label: A document establishing the expert’s profession
requirements.source_excerpt: 14- a document that underlines the foreigner’s profession.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: 14- A document that underlines the foreigner’s profession.

requirements.label: Insurance procured BY THE ENTERPRISE for the whole stay
requirements.description: The obligation is the enterprise's, not the expert's.
requirements.source_excerpt: 15- an insurance is procured by the enterprise in favor of the worker during his stay in lebanon.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: 15- An insurance is procured by the enterprise in favor of the worker during his stay in Lebanon.

requirements.label: A valid residence permit, if the expert lives outside their country of origin
requirements.description: Conditional, and the condition is stated.
requirements.source_excerpt: 16- a valid residence permit for the worker if his country of residence is not his country of origin.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: 16- A valid residence permit for the worker if his country of residence is not his country of origin.

requirements.label: The company’s ledger showing what work the expert was brought to do
requirements.source_excerpt: 17- the company’s ledger showing the object of the work the expert was brought to do, as well as other relevant information.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: 17- The company’s ledger showing the object of the work the expert was brought to do, as well as other relevant information.

requirements.label: Stays beyond one month: the first-class worker modalities apply instead
requirements.description: The authority does not extend this route — it redirects to a different regime whose requirements are not published on this page. The question and its answer are quoted together because either alone says nothing.
requirements.source_excerpt: 2- if the length of his stay exceeds one month: ... the modalities required are those prescribed for a first class worker .
requirements.source_excerpt_display: 2- If the length of his stay exceeds one month: ... The modalities required are those prescribed for a first class worker.

requirements.label: Foreign sailors and sailing specialists boarding foreign ships get a TRANSIT visa
requirements.description: The authority names superintendent, inspector and marine surveyor itself. No document list is published for this route and none is invented.
requirements.source_excerpt: when it comes to foreign sailors and foreign sailing specialists (superintendant, inspector, marine surveyor) wanting to get on foreign ships, they are granted a " transit visa " to do so.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: When it comes to foreign sailors and foreign sailing specialists (Superintendant, Inspector, Marine Surveyor) wanting to get on foreign ships, they are granted a " transit visa " to do so.
